# Session (Anthropic)

Anthropic's "session" is the industry's [session][industry.session], and the word the industry's card takes from it: "A conversation tied to your current directory, with its own independent context window" ([Claude Code glossary][a3]). A Claude Code session is made of turns and stored as a transcript, so it can be resumed.

## Examples

- A Claude Code session, local or in the cloud.
